scope: UI, including shared KEYS editor bindings; VS Code actions have a separate inventory
note: Registry completeness and source references do not establish runtime acceptance.

operations.result: One per-tool target set supplies toolbar labels, transaction refs, pivot and preview geometry; move/rotate eligible placements, side only layered members, point anchor route; automatic and isolated own placements excluded

operations.title: move and placement coordinates
operations.context: eligible placement; drag or source-frame X/Y fields with units

operations.missingAcceptance: gesture, drag-txn, edit-path-gestures/grids; real installed source/undo/delayed facets

operations.title: rotate
operations.context: R, compass ring or degree field
operations.result: shared grid pivot or placement origin; numeric source-frame rotation
operations.boundary: W third at value; Escape ring cancel, one undo
operations.missingAcceptance: ring, gesture; R currently no held pose, zero angle formatting

operations.title: flip
operations.context: L or Front/Back placement selector

operations.boundary: W one undo; no transient preview currently
operations.missingAcceptance: gesture, edit-path-gestures; visual final B/origin and delayed compilation

operations.title: trace navigation and insertion

operations.boundary: W; reroute patch only required non-source copper; Escape cancel
operations.missingAcceptance: gesture, route-ends, edit-path-gestures; bound vs automatic route exact source

operations.title: delete trace segment
operations.context: Delete icon or Delete/Backspace on selected primitive

operations.missingAcceptance: gesture; keyboard field protection and point endpoint boundaries

operations.title: undo/redo
operations.context: Mod Z / Mod Shift Z
